name: Etanitia
source:
Main character Helios heads to the capital city of Etantia with two strange companions. They talk for a while till they start hearing a voice and stop. The voice comes from the direction of the village that brought God's judgement upon itself. Young people move out to investigate it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
